title: Step
description: One node of a process graph. Every step carries its method, the reason for the choice, the alternatives rejected and, for any method that can vary, a fallback. Every step that produces a result carries its exactness class; wait and human produce none and carry no class (ADR-0018). Two rules from ADR-0014 and ADR-0004 are enforced here: a step classed exact takes its result from rule or statistics only, and a step on llm or worker names a fallback. A step on ml or neural pins its model version, because that is what makes it reproducible.

id.description: Stable name of the step inside its process, lowercase with hyphens.

reason.description: Why this method was chosen for this step.

rejected.description: The alternatives considered and why they were not chosen. Empty when there was nothing to reject.

exactness.description: How wrong the result may be. Required for every result-producing method, absent for wait and human (ADR-0018).

fallback.description: Where the step goes when the chosen method is not good enough. Mandatory for llm and worker.

when.description: The condition that triggers the fallback, stated so that it can be evaluated: confidence < 0.9, tests failed twice.

model.description: The model this step runs on, pinned as name@version. Required for ml and neural.

requires.description: Capabilities the executing adapter must offer. Never a product name.

depends_on.description: Steps of the same process that must finish before this one starts. The edges of the graph.
